dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: Do you have any fluffy animals around here? Cats, dogs, foxes... I'm not picky. I'll even take sheep in a pinch.

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: Most importantly, though... Do they listen to you?

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: I just want something to cuddle. Don't worry, I won't run off with your pets.

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: Hmph, now you're making fun of me.

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: Didn't I tell you? Wild animals usually don't like getting close to me.

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: They have their own complex sensory systems. I can't win them over just by adjusting my temperature module or tweaking my smile.

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: And trust me, I've tried. But even a genius of my standing can't find a way.

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: So, the easiest solution is to find someone they trust and then have them gently assure the animals that I'm a good person who won't hurt them.

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: Exactly! But Nefer's always looking to discuss this and negotiate that. Dropping by occasionally is fine, but it's too much effort to constantly focus on her conversation.

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: Well, now you've really opened a can of very angry worms!

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: One day, I was going to see Katheryne in Nasha Town for a little business, when a Rimehorn Deer suddenly ran out of nowhere and started nudging me.

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: The fur on its neck was very soft and warm, and its antlers felt quite novel to the touch...

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: But when I turned around, I caught Columbina watching me with a smile.

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: "Sandrone, all the little animals are hiding from you. You look so pitiful. I told them you aren't a bad person, that you're actually quite gentle, and that you go to sleep hugging—"

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: I'm not telling you the rest! The point is, who's she calling pitiful? I don't need little animals for company! She told them secrets about me! It's a total violation!

choices.text: She was just being considerate of your feelings...

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: Stop changing the subject! Do you have any fluffy animals or not!?

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: Yes! But Lauma seldom leaves the Frostmoon Enclave. As a Fatui Harbinger, I'm not exactly a welcome sight around there. It wouldn't do to keep parading myself up and down in front of them.
